suites.name: LiveCodeBench
suites.separation_evidence: Use a time-based slice newer than every training source cutoff; record problems, dates, repository revision, execution image, and deny-list hashes.
suites.notes: Coding remains P2 and diagnostic until a dedicated owner/data route is approved; 80 is a stretch goal only under that route.

suites.name: EvalPlus
suites.separation_evidence: Public benchmark repositories are contamination-prone; use diagnostically unless exact repository and derivative exclusion is demonstrated.

suites.name: Protected multilingual defect-repair holdout
suites.separation_evidence: Use held-out repositories/tasks with no shared bug, patch, issue text, test, or generated derivative in training.
suites.language_scope: tier-stratified natural-language prompts and multiple programming languages
suites.notes: Set floors after the base run; report language, code language, defect class, and tool use.

suites.name: Secure coding audit
suites.separation_evidence: Threat model and protected task set are not yet approved.
suites.notes: Cover secrets, injection, unsafe deserialization, auth, permissions, and dependency handling.

gaps: Pinned execution images and dependency policy
